review_method.comparison: Every accepted compiled statement read against the hash-matching cited physical page and section context; quantities, units, actors, modality, conditions, exceptions, standalone wording and material omissions checked.
review_method.evidence_locators: Line numbers refer to raw registered page text split on newline, including empty lines. Each raw page text was hash-verified against the immutable page map before reading.
review_method.structural_context_policy: A continuing list may use its immediately preceding section heading as structural context, explicitly recorded. A substantive sentence split across two pages is not certified under the one-page fact rule.
review_method.source_authority: The staged official Kansas guide is the authority for this comparison. No new current-law, clinical or equipment research was performed.
review_method.limitations: PASS means semantic fidelity to this staged source with stated context; it is not independent 07/08 acceptance, source-currency clearance, visual inspection or acceptance of proposed corrections.
review_method.fan_out: No nested author or reviewer in this turn; prior limited findings were re-examined against actual pages.
